reuse.why: Uses db.first and the existing AccountSyncSource type; adds one guard helper rather than reimplementing anything existing, though link.ts (the module for link-related bank lookups like findOrCreateBank) was not reused as its home.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one helper; only a 5-line call is repeated in each of the five provider link functions, which mirrors the tree's already duplicated per-provider structure.

placement.why: Guard is a private function in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers; link.ts holds the analogous findOrCreateBank DB helper and would be a slightly more natural home.

scope.why: Focused on the guard plus tests; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers is adjacent typing cleanup, not strictly required.

maintainability.why: Single clearly-named guard with explicit upgradingId exception is easy to own; a new provider must remember to add the call, as with the other per-provider steps.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; the check is a new guard called first in every link*Account function

disguised_duplication.where: none; only the guard invocation repeats per provider

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts is the single definition, called by all five link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking)
